import bpy, os, json, statistics
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
EXPECTED=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=EXPECTED: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
terrain=bpy.data.objects.get('WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout'); tower=bpy.data.objects.get('V4 | torre documental'); hall=bpy.data.objects.get('V4 | hall piso terreo marcador'); upper=bpy.data.objects.get('V4 | estacao laje 0')
if not all((terrain,tower,hall,upper)): raise RuntimeError('base incompleta')
verts=[terrain.matrix_world@v.co for v in terrain.data.vertices]; polys=[tuple(p.vertices) for p in terrain.data.polygons]; bvh=BVHTree.FromPolygons(verts,polys,all_triangles=False)
def rayz(p):
    h=bvh.ray_cast(Vector((p.x,p.y,250)),Vector((0,0,-1)),600); return None if h[0] is None else float(h[0].z)

# proposta V2 documentada no script existente
W=14.832; D=16.5; PILLAR=.62; center_s=-3.25; center_l=-9.27; front_s=center_s-D/2; rear_s=center_s+D/2; bay=(W-2*PILLAR)/3
front_lats=[center_l-W/2+PILLAR/2,center_l-bay,center_l,center_l+bay,center_l+W/2-PILLAR/2]
front=[]

    p=P(front_s,l); front.append({'s':front_s,'l':round(l,3),'xy':[round(p.x,3),round(p.y,3)],'terrain_z':round(rayz(p),4)})

# amostras traseiras da proposta

for l in (center_l-W/2,center_l,center_l+W/2):
    p=P(rear_s,l); rear.append({'s':rear_s,'l':round(l,3),'terrain_z':round(rayz(p),4)})
# estação alta: projeta todos os 8 corners da laje0 e identifica bordas min/max s
corners=[]
for c in upper.bound_box:
    q=upper.matrix_world@Vector(c); rel=q.xy-T; s=float(rel.dot(EX)); l=float(rel.dot(EY)); corners.append({'s':s,'l':l,'z':q.z})
smin=min(c['s'] for c in corners);smax=max(c['s'] for c in corners);lmin=min(c['l'] for c in corners);lmax=max(c['l'] for c in corners)
upper_edges=[]
for s,label in ((smin,'LOW_SIDE'),(smax,'HIGH_SIDE')):
    for l in (lmin,(lmin+lmax)/2,lmax):
        p=P(s,l);upper_edges.append({'edge':label,'s':round(s,3),'l':round(l,3),'terrain_z':round(rayz(p),4)})
# procura ao longo do eixo onde terreno chega ao piso atual e ao piso candidato baseado na mediana da fachada baixa
low_ground=statistics.median(front_z); current_upper_z=min((upper.matrix_world@Vector(c)).z for c in upper.bound_box); candidate_upper_z=low_ground+59.0
def crossing(target):
    best=None
    for i in range(0,1201):
        s=30+i*0.025;z=rayz(P(s,0))
        if z is None:continue
        e=abs(z-target)
        if best is None or e<best[0]:best=(e,s,z)
    return None if best is None else {'s':round(best[1],3),'terrain_z':round(best[2],4),'error':round(best[0],4)}
report={'proposal_lower_v2':{'center_s':center_s,'center_l':center_l,'front_s':front_s,'rear_s':rear_s,'front_samples':front,'front_ground_median_z':round(low_ground,4),'rear_samples':rear},'upper_floor':{'current_z':round(current_upper_z,4),'candidate_z_from_low_plus_59':round(candidate_upper_z,4),'bounds_s':[round(smin,3),round(smax,3)],'bounds_l':[round(lmin,3),round(lmax,3)],'edge_samples':upper_edges,'terrain_cross_current_z':crossing(current_upper_z),'terrain_cross_candidate_z':crossing(candidate_upper_z)},'recommended_global_z_delta_if_preserve_59':round(low_ground-0.4549102783203125,4)}
